To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the patients with bronchasthma have increased oxidative stress in blood and bronchial lumen.

(a) patients with bronchasthma of various degrees of severity have been studied (b) an increase in processes of the lipid peroxidation (c) a depression of antioxidant protection (d) an increase in oxide nitrogen metabolism products in the blood serum and condensation of exhaled air have been detected (e) these pathological changes may be regarded as manifestations of a systemic oxidative stress, more pronounced in the bronchi.
the patients with bronchospasm had a higher level of oxidative stress than those with bronchial obstruction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the antioxidant protection, metabolites nitrogen oxide and oxidative stress in patients of bronchial asthma.
the study of the mechanisms of the development of the oxidative stress in patients suffering from bronchial asthma.

the fact that the level of lipid peroxidization, the activity of antioxidant enzymes, the content of nitric oxide and its metabolites in the blood serum and exhaled air condensate of bronchial asthma patients are significantly higher than the corresponding indicators in healthy subjects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the patients with bronchospastic disease, especially with bronchial obstruction syndrome have a significant increase of oxidative stress in blood and in condensate of the air exhaled.
the oxidative stress is a key factor for development of the bronchial asthma.
oxidative stress in bronchial asthma is a multifactorial process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the increase of oxidative stress in bronchi may be considered as one of the main mechanisms of bronchial asthma pathogenesis and its development.

in the patients with bronchospastic syndrome the processes of oxidative stress are expressed more in bronchi, than in the general circulation, and they are more expressed in patients with bronchi hyperreactivity, than in those with bronchi obstruction.
the processes of lipid per oxidation, depression of antioxidant defense, increase in oxide metabolites of nitrogen in bronchi and in blood serum are the main pathogenetic links of bronchial asthma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of antioxidants and NO metabolites in patients with asthma may be considered as a new method of therapy.
